title: inferCSN 1.2.5
text: inferCSN now keeps inference core : inferCSN(), single_network(), fit_greedy_l0(), fit_greedy_l0_batch(), network_format(), filter_sort_matrix(). Added backward-deletion refinement pass batch greedy-L0 solver (fit_greedy_l0_batch()), removing predictors longer improve BIC forward selection, avoids -selecting support near perfect fits. Group numerically tied deletion evidence fixed group maximum using relative tolerance 1e-12 computing signed ordinal weights. Added direct-QR regression checks batch coefficients, BIC, deletion evidence, near-perfect-fit behavior. Cell preprocessing (meta_cells() subsampling()) now lives multiCSN; call multiCSN::meta_cells() multiCSN::subsampling() instead. Remove unused gtools RTransferEntropy suggestions. Drop plotting evaluation dependencies (ggplot2, thisplot, patchwork, precrec, pROC). Remove RANN, igraph, irlba, proxy package moving cell preprocessing multiCSN. Drop scatter-network-plot Suggests (ggExtra, ggpointdensity, ggpubr, RColorBrewer, viridis, ggnetwork, ggraph, dplyr, purrr, ComplexHeatmap, circlize, gganimate, network, plotly, tidygraph). Fixed failing package CI checks. Removed unused dev/config_attachment.yaml.

title: inferCSN 1.2.4
text: Replaced fit_srm() greedy-L0 interfaces fit_greedy_l0() fit_greedy_l0_batch(). Replaced legacy regularization, cross-validation, subsampling arguments inferCSN() pseudotime, max_support_size, lag_fraction, lag_steps. Added static pseudotime-ordered network inference dense sparse matrices, including multi-branch pseudotime deterministic parallel output. Added early-precision, signed-edge, motif, path, cross-run stability metrics. Extended plot_network_heatmap() aligned multi-network layouts, performance labels, ground-truth cell borders. Removed L0Learn added thisplot plotting support. Added R-hub platform checks manual CRAN release checks, updated checkout actions v5. Updated generated documentation, examples, example datasets, pkgdown reference index.
